# CLI Changelog Changes

Record only externally observable changes to the versioned Luna CLI. Exclude
independently versioned pack packages, documentation, CI, build, test,
release-process, refactoring, and other internal maintenance changes. Add new
entries under `Unreleased`, use existing consumer-facing categories and
terminology, and describe outcomes rather than implementation details.
